## What happened

The change recorded under ref CHG-0152 was titled Patient merge batch applied. The batch was applied on 2023-05-15. This notice provides a record of the change and its known effect on patient information and associated studies.

## Cause

The recorded cause was Duplicate clean-up. The batch was used as part of this clean-up activity. No further cause is recorded in this notice.

## Effect

Some studies attached to the wrong person as a result of the change. This may affect the accuracy of information associated with the relevant patient records and should be considered when reviewing those records. The effect identified in this notice is limited to the attachment of studies to the wrong person.

Questions about this notice should be directed to the service desk, quoting CHG-0152.
